values.meaning: missing health amplification per 1% missing health, capped at 66.66%
values.quote: {{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100*2/3|formula=1.5% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health. ''This is capped at 66.66% '''missing''' health.''}}
values.binNote: MaxExecuteMult=2 matches the max damage being 2x min damage (100% missing hp * 1.5%/1% -> 150% amp = 2x min damage at cap); the 1.5%-per-1% scaling formula and 66.66% cap are only stated in the wiki tooltip text, not as a separate bin row.

mechanics.claim: Deals magic damage based on the target's missing health, scaling from minimum at full health to maximum (2x) at or above 66.66% missing health.
The ability can be blocked by spell shields.
The damage is delivered by a projectile, so it lands after travel time rather than instantly on cast.
